note: The dated change log on /bitcoin-lenders (JM's rulings 2026-10-01: a section above the cards plus card badges and per-card history; seeded with the changes the 2026-09-30 research found with exact, sourced dates; every monthly re-read logged even when nothing changed). Newest entries may go anywhere: the index (lenderLogIndex.js) sorts by date. kind: 'check' (a re-read of the cards; give read and changed counts) | 'page' (a card added or removed) | 'lender' (something the lender changed). type, for kind 'lender' or 'page': 'rate' | 'terms' | 'availability' | 'launch' | 'added' | 'removed' | 'exit'. lender: the card id in lenders.json. source: the lender's own page for the change. Procedure: MONTHLY_REFRESH_CHECKLIST §7.6.

entries.text: Added to the page: Cadena Bitcoin, the only Discreet Log Contract lender here. Twenty cards.
Page published. All nineteen cards read from each lender’s own pages, every figure dated.
Kraken Borrow launched in the US: buying power on Kraken, not a cash loan you can withdraw.
APX cut its liquidation fee to 0% and moved to partial liquidation: it now sells only enough bitcoin to bring the loan back to 85%.
Hodl Hodl Lend’s new terms bar US citizens, residents and anyone in the US, reversing its 2020 opening to US users.
Nexo returned to the US through Bakkt, three years after leaving.
